noticias.titular: Luis Arraez (ankle) out as Phillies eye 5th straight playoff
noticias.texto: Phillies second baseman Luis Arraez will sit against the Tampa Bay Rays on Friday night because of a sprained ankle. Philadelphia needs at least one win to move closer to its fifth straight playoff berth.
